senses.gloss: (tradit. pronunc. שְׁתּוּת) f. (denom. of Chald. שִׁתְּ) one-sixth.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:3">B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>ש׳ למקח</he> one-sixth of the value of a purchased object (v. <cite ref="A00722"><he>אוֹנָאָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 49b:10">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>רב אמר ש׳ מקח שנינו</he> Rab says, the Mishnah means one-sixth of the value only; <he>ושמואל אמר ש׳ מעות וכ׳</he> but Samuel says, the Mishnah means also one-sixth of the price paid (one-fifth of the value).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 90a:5">B. Bath. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מוסיפין … יותר מש׳</he> you dare not decree the increase of a measure by more than one-sixth, nor of the weight of a coin &c.; <he>המשתכר … יותר מש׳</he> he that makes profit (retailer) must not charge more than one-sixth profit; <cite ref="Menachot 77a:7">Men. 77ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:2">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
